status: Unreleased native QuickJS execution reentry. Public SDK/runtime and production remain 0.19.2; this is not the public contexts API.

nativeBoundary.reentry: Guest.begin keeps the original QuickJS runtime, globals, functions and native ESM cache. It accepts a validated next module graph only after the previous execution is quiescent.
nativeBoundary.renewed: Output, supplied process.env fields, interrupt fuel, microtask count and capability/module request count are renewed. Context memory/output ceilings remain fixed at construction.
nativeBoundary.cache: Unchanged module sources and bindings retain their native identity/state. A changed cached source or reused entry identity fails before registry mutation. Incoming and retained sources share the existing 128-module and 8 MiB graph limits.
nativeBoundary.authority: This fixture exposes no production endpoint. Outstanding callbacks and queued microtasks block reentry; public per-execution authorization and exclusive durable ownership remain to be implemented.
nativeBoundary.lifetime: Each fixture Worker owns isolated Wasm bindings. Scoped finalizers free a live Guest; parking consumes its handle and transfers ownership before the memory copy. Earlier Workers are fully disposed before replacement opens their native R2 state.

replacementProof.operation: Save a pending echo callback with a lexical variable initialized to 40 and a global function closing over that variable and the original console.

Restore from real R2, resolve echo with 2, complete first result 43 and stdout first/closure. Begin a second program in the same context: result 42 and only second/closure output. Save the completed native heap again.
Restore the second R2 image and begin a third program: result 43 and only third/closure output. No source replay or JSON reconstruction of variables/functions.
